description: "Extracts from 'Sikes on Parochial Communion' by Thomas Sikes" is a theological treatise and compilation written during the mid-19th century. The work seeks to address the issues of episcopal authority, schism, and ecclesiastical obedience within the context of Christian worship and governance.
